Mummichog network analysis independently awards its top rank (p = 0.00218) to MUMM:c21_steroid_hormone_biosynthesis_and_metabolism, where all 10 input compounds are mapped to steroid network nodes; its second rank (p = 0.00328) is MUMM:androgen_and_estrogen_biosynthesis_and_metabolism with 9 hits.
